description: Continental + phenomenology decomposed. Husserl's epoché + transcendental ego, Heidegger's Dasein + being-in-the-world, Merleau-Ponty's embodiment, Sartre's bad faith, Levinas's Other, Foucault's power-knowledge, Derrida's deconstruction.

sub_mechanisms.name: Husserl_epoche
sub_mechanisms.definition: Phenomenological reduction: bracket question of existence; describe pure experience.
sub_mechanisms.why: Method of phenomenology. Suspend natural attitude. Focus on intentional structures of consciousness.

sub_mechanisms.name: Husserl_intentionality_structures
sub_mechanisms.definition: Noesis (act) + noema (object as intended). Every consciousness consciousness-of.
sub_mechanisms.why: Phenomenological method. Detailed structure of intentional acts. Foundation of phenomenology.

sub_mechanisms.name: Heidegger_Dasein
sub_mechanisms.definition: Being-there. Human existence as concernful engagement with world.
sub_mechanisms.why: Being + Time 1927. Foundation: human as situated, not detached subject. Influence on existentialism, hermeneutics.

sub_mechanisms.name: Heidegger_being_in_world
sub_mechanisms.definition: Not subject + object. Dasein always already in world, engaged with things.
sub_mechanisms.why: Anti-Cartesian. Foundation of embodied + situated cognition. Influence on AI: robotics, embodied AI.

sub_mechanisms.name: Heidegger_ready_to_hand
sub_mechanisms.definition: Tool absorbed in skillful use. Vs present-at-hand: tool as object of contemplation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hammer in use vs hammer examined. Foundation of skill acquisition philosophy. Dreyfus + AI applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: Merleau_Ponty_embodiment
sub_mechanisms.definition: Body as locus of meaning. Not Cartesian flesh. Body schema, motor intentionality.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of embodied cognition. Influence on cognitive science (Varela), AI (robotics). Substrate's sensorimotor aligns.

sub_mechanisms.name: Sartre_bad_faith
sub_mechanisms.definition: Self-deception about one's own freedom. Waiter playing waiter, claiming determination.
sub_mechanisms.why: Existentialist ethics. Authenticity vs bad faith. Critical of essentialism. Foundation existentialism.

sub_mechanisms.name: Levinas_face_of_other
sub_mechanisms.definition: Ethics as first philosophy. Face of Other = primordial ethical demand.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of post-Holocaust ethics. Asymmetric obligation. Influence on contemporary ethics + Continental thought.

sub_mechanisms.name: Foucault_power_knowledge
sub_mechanisms.definition: Knowledge + power inseparable. Power produces knowledge; knowledge enables power.
sub_mechanisms.why: Discipline + Punish, Birth of Clinic. Influence: critical theory, post-structuralism. Foundation: subject as constituted.

sub_mechanisms.name: Derrida_deconstruction
sub_mechanisms.definition: Texts undermine own structure. Hierarchical oppositions destabilised. Différance.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of post-structuralism. Reading practice + philosophy. Influence: literary criticism, hermeneutics.

sub_mechanisms.name: Dreyfus_AI_critique
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hubert Dreyfus: AI needs embodied skill, not symbol manipulation. Heideggerian critique.
sub_mechanisms.why: What Computers Can't Do 1972. Influence on embodied AI. LLM era reignites debate. Substrate's authored approach engages.

sub_mechanisms.name: Gadamer_horizon_fusion
sub_mechanisms.definition: Understanding = fusion of interpreter's horizon with text's. Hermeneutic circle.
sub_mechanisms.why: Truth + Method 1960. Foundation hermeneutics. Influence: humanities methodology. AI: how does machine interpretation work?

derivation_rules.name: phenomenology_method_via_epoche
derivation_rules.why: Husserl's method. Foundation. Avoid presuppositions about external world. Focus on what's given in consciousness.

derivation_rules.name: being_in_world_overcomes_Cartesian_dualism
derivation_rules.why: Dasein always already engaged. No detached subject viewing objects. Influence: embodied cognition. Substrate's worldly entity, not internal model.

derivation_rules.name: embodiment_grounds_meaning
derivation_rules.why: Merleau-Ponty + enactivism. Disembodied AI may miss this. Substrate's sensorimotor cortex aligns. Modern cognitive science incorporates.

derivation_rules.name: Dreyfus_skill_critique_relevant_to_AI
if: AI claimed to have human-like understanding
derivation_rules.why: Symbol manipulation may not capture skill. Modern: LLMs spectacular without embodied skill. Critique partially answered, partially open.

derivation_rules.name: hermeneutic_circle_for_interpretation
derivation_rules.why: Cannot understand part without whole; whole without parts. Gadamer. Foundation humanities + interpretive AI questions.
